description.value:
Deep colour-and-texture cells grown off a cephalopod-thing from the Drowned Coast. At will, 1 action: become concealed by a blur of shifting pattern until you move more than 10 feet or use a hostile action. Hold still for 1 minute (2 actions to begin) to take on the look of an object or a person of your size — a Deception check to Impersonate, with a +2 item bonus to the visual component.

Rider: Strong feeling strobes you. On a failed save against fear, or a natural 1 on any save, you flash a vivid warning pattern and every creature within 30 feet that can see you knows exactly where you are until the end of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: The core ability is a two-tier activated disguise (an at-will blur and a 1-minute transformation with its own Deception check) -- an activated ability with its own duration and check needs a granted Action item; the fear-triggered warning-flash rider is a narrative trigger, not an engine-recognizable one.
